Home.connectNote: Peregrine matches you with the best local guide for your location, interests, and availability — then you plan the details together.
Home.whySubtitle: Experience tourism the way it should be: personal, authentic, and sustainable.
Home.whyHiddenBody: Discover places only locals know, far from tourist crowds and guidebook cliches.
Home.whyVerifiedBody: All guides are reviewed and verified, so you can explore with complete peace of mind.
Home.whyPassionateBody: Connect with locals who genuinely love sharing their culture, stories, and traditions.
Home.whyImpactBody: Support local communities directly while exploring responsibly and sustainably.
Home.howSubtitle: Start your adventure in three simple steps.
Home.howStep1Body: Tell us where you are and what you’re into. We’ll surface the best local guides for your vibe and timing.
Home.howStep2Body: Pick a guide, connect, and share your preferences. The guide helps shape a plan that fits you.
Home.howStep3Body: You and your guide iron out the route, pace, stops, and special requests — no cookie-cutter tours.
Home.guideBody: Turn local knowledge into income. Set your hourly rate, open the time that suits you, and agree the details directly with each traveller.
Home.guideFeature1Body: You publish the dates you are available — no minimum commitment.
Home.guideFeature2Body: Set your hourly rate, your largest group, and the slots you open. No catalogue, no fixed tours.
Home.guideFeature3Body: Applications are reviewed before a guide profile goes live.
Home.guideFeature4Body: Travellers reach you through the platform, and you approve each request.

BecomeGuide.heroTitle: Share Your City, Earn Your Way
BecomeGuide.heroBody: Turn your local knowledge into income. Set your hourly rate, open the time that suits you, and agree the details directly with each traveller.
BecomeGuide.benefitsSubtitle: Join a platform designed to support you in sharing your passion while building a sustainable income
BecomeGuide.benefitPricesBody: You set your hourly rate. Payment is arranged directly between you and your guests.
BecomeGuide.benefitScheduleBody: Work when you want. Set your availability and accept bookings that fit your schedule.
BecomeGuide.benefitPeopleBody: Connect with curious travelers from around the world and make lasting friendships.
BecomeGuide.benefitPassionBody: Show off the places you love and share the stories that make your city special.
BecomeGuide.benefitDashboardBody: Manage your slots, booking requests, and reviews from a single place.
BecomeGuide.benefitReviewedBody: Every application is reviewed before a profile goes live, and you approve each booking request yourself.
BecomeGuide.stepsSubtitle: From application to your first traveller in just a few simple steps
BecomeGuide.step1Body: Fill out a simple application telling us about yourself, your city, and the experiences you want to share.
BecomeGuide.step2Body: Every application is reviewed manually before a guide profile goes live. You get a notification as soon as there is a decision.
BecomeGuide.step3Body: Write a little about yourself, set your hourly rate and your largest group, then open your first slots. Travellers ask for you, not for a product.
BecomeGuide.step4Body: Start receiving bookings! Manage your calendar, communicate with guests, and share unforgettable experiences while earning income doing what you love.
BecomeGuide.formSubtitle: Fill out the application below. We review each one and notify you when there is a decision.
BecomeGuide.tourIdeasPlaceholder: Tell us what you love showing travellers…

BecomeGuide.faq1Question: How much can I earn as a guide?
BecomeGuide.faq1Answer: You set your hourly rate, so what you earn depends on that and on how much time you open up. Peregrine does not process payments and does not take a cut — you arrange payment directly with your guests.
BecomeGuide.faq2Question: Do I need professional guiding experience?
BecomeGuide.faq2Answer: No. We welcome locals of all experience levels. What matters most is your knowledge of your city and your enthusiasm for sharing it — you describe your experience in the application and it is taken into account during review.
BecomeGuide.faq3Question: How long does the application process take?
BecomeGuide.faq3Answer: Each application is reviewed manually, so the timing varies. You will get a notification as soon as there is a decision, and your guide dashboard opens up right after approval.
BecomeGuide.faq4Question: What support do you provide to guides?
BecomeGuide.faq4Answer: Your dashboard covers the day-to-day: opening slots, approving or declining requests, notifications for every request, calendar export for confirmed bookings, and the reviews left on your profile.
